hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] || { (sh scripts/setup-graphify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0; }; graphify hook-guard search 2>/dev/null || true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] || { (sh scripts/setup-graphify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0; }; graphify hook-guard read 2>/dev/null || true
command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify hook-guard compact 2>/dev/null || true
